# Takanori Kotama - Portfolio

> This is the personal portfolio of Takanori Kotama, a Computer Science student at Nagoya University.

This site provides a chat-based UI to explore my profile, skills, research, and projects.

## API for LLM Agents

A unified JSON endpoint is available for programmatic access to all portfolio data.

### Endpoint

GET https://fir-939f3.web.app/agent

### Parameters

- `lang` (optional): `en` (default) or `ja`
- `section` (optional): filter by section name

### Available Sections

- `profile`: Name, affiliation, graduation, awards, contact, ORCID
- `bio`: Career and education timeline
- `skills`: Programming languages, frameworks, tools, HPC, spoken languages
- `interests`: Research interests and hobbies
- `theses`: Summaries of published theses (Encouragement Award, FuSEP, Graduation)
- `projects`: Major GitHub projects with descriptions and stars
- `contributions`: Open-source contributions
- `research`: Research works and publications (sourced from ORCID)
- `links`: GitHub, Qiita, X, LinkedIn, ORCID profile URLs
- `contact`: Email address

### Examples

Fetch all data in English:
GET /agent

Fetch skills in Japanese:
GET /agent?section=skills&lang=ja

Fetch research works only:
GET /agent?section=research
